title: Geometric Dream Portrait
description: A close-up portrait of a woman with long flowing dark hair and orange eyes, her face covered in colorful geometric triangular patterns in purple, yellow, and blue. To her right, an orange horse with white spots gallops through a surreal green landscape filled with flowers, vines, and an infinity symbol.
prompt: Surreal portrait of a young woman with long flowing dark hair and striking orange eyes, her face adorned with colorful geometric triangular patterns in purple, cyan, and yellow. An orange spotted horse gallops beside her through a vibrant green field with pink flowers and swirling green vines forming an infinity symbol. Dreamlike fantasy atmosphere with soft bokeh orbs in the background, painterly style with visible brushwork.
